name: Automotive Supply Center
old_description: Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has served the Hilo community since 1955. Our inventory of new and rebuilt automotive parts, supplies, and paint means you can be sure to find everything for a foreign or domestic car, truck, and high-performance vehicles. ASC is the auto parts shop to equip your vehicle and keep it running at optimum performance. We also have three warehouses stocked with a variety of automotive parts to serve you.
about:
Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has operated in Hilo, Hawaii since 1955. Founded by brothers Kazuichi and Hayato Okino, the business began with five employees on Piopio Street. A 1960 tsunami destroyed the original shop, prompting a move to Kanoelehua Industrial Park and later to its current location at 411 E Kawili St. in 1996. Today, the company remains family-run under Peter Okino and his son Darin Okino, who oversee a staff of over 35.

ASC functions as a distributor and retailer of automotive parts and accessories, stocking new and rebuilt components for domestic and imported cars, light trucks, heavy trucks, and 4x4 vehicles. Its three warehouses carry motor parts, electrical components, air-conditioning parts, batteries, detailing products, body supplies, fluids, tools, and equipment. The inventory spans thousands of part numbers across passenger and commercial vehicle lines.

The company serves the entire Big Island, supplying individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and fleet operators. Its customer base includes owners of foreign and domestic cars, light and heavy trucks, and high-performance vehicles. Staff assist with part identification for specific makes, models, years, engines, and drivetrains.

ASC attributes its longevity to a knowledgeable workforce, many recruited from Hawaii Community College’s auto body and repair programs, with several employees exceeding 30 years of tenure. The company emphasizes breadth of inventory and personalized service as its competitive foundation.
